package: @astryxdesign/core

# DialogFullscreenDialog - Takes over the entire viewport for content that needs maximum space. Use for documentation viewers, rich text editors, multi-step wizards, or media previews where the standard dialog width is too narrow.
# Components: Card, Dialog, Layout

<Card>
  <VStack gap={3}>
    <VStack gap={1}>
      <Text />
      <Text />
    </VStack>
    <Button variant="secondary" />
  </VStack>
  <Dialog variant="fullscreen">
    <Layout />
    /* header: */
    <DialogHeader />
    /* content: */
    <LayoutContent>
      <VStack gap={4}>
        <VStack gap={1}>
          <Text />
          <Text />
        </VStack>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>
    /* footer: */
    <LayoutFooter>
      <Button variant="primary" />
    </LayoutFooter>
  </Dialog>
</Card>
